safety_semantic_judgments.k_anonymity_minimums: 5 present in scope_reports, prompt_visibility, prompt_visibility_posture, prompt_visibility_admin_share, prompt_visibility_admin_share_posture; 20 present in both *_posture visibility keys; each stated as a minimum ('at least') with the 'only when' restriction intact.
safety_semantic_judgments.retentions: 14 days in scope_trace_detail ('kept'), 90 days stats and 180 days reports in revoke_retained, {backup_days} preserved in revoke_body_trace; none reworded into a different period or a deletion promise.
safety_semantic_judgments.never_sent_list: prompt_never_sent keeps all six items (file paths, commands, prompts, code, model output, tool arguments) under a 'never' negation.
safety_semantic_judgments.card_footer: 'Guard collects nothing for {org}' kept org-scoped (not a global 'collects nothing').
safety_semantic_judgments.report_confirmed_no_auto_send: Every locale says saved on this computer, not sent, sending not live yet, and that Guard asks again before sending to {org}; no locale promises an automatic send.
safety_semantic_judgments.other_consent_lines: prompt_reason_widened (keeps sharing only what you agreed to), prompt_reason_reactivated/plan_gap (nothing shared until you choose), revoke_body/_trace, revoke_totals, scope_reports (no one at {org} can open; Radient staff only on request or legal requirement), readonly_agent ('may be driving', not 'is') checked in all seven locales.

safety_semantic_judgments.minimums: Visibility is restricted to at least 5 contributors for totals and 20 for setup-check estimates; report count is per kind and requires at least five senders that day.
safety_semantic_judgments.retentions: Step-by-step timing excludes contents and is kept 14 days. Already sent records retain the 90-day stats/180-day reports distinction; backup removal is within {backup_days} days.
safety_semantic_judgments.never_sent: All six categories remain inside the never-send clause: file paths, commands, prompts, code, model output, and tool arguments.
safety_semantic_judgments.organization_scope: The non-Team footer applies to the named {org}, not every organization, and neither organization admins nor other members can open the report.
safety_semantic_judgments.report_confirmation: Saved locally and not sent; sending is not live yet, and Guard asks the person again before sending to {org}. No automatic send is implied.
safety_semantic_judgments.consent_condition: Widening retains only prior scope until the person chooses; reactivation and lapsed plan require a fresh choice. The prospective sending list is not an unconditional claim.
